title: Classification of quadratically pinched translators in higher codimension
summary: We study complete translating solitons for the mean curvature flow in arbitrary codimension under quadratic pinching of the second fundamental form. We prove a codimension reduction theorem at the Andrews-Baker threshold: if a complete $n$-dimensional connected translator isometrically immersed in $(\mathbb{R}^{n+p},\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle)$ satisfies \[ |B|^2\leq \left(\frac{4}{3n}-\varepsilon_{0}\right)|H|^2 \] for some $\varepsilon_{0}>0$, then either it is an affine $n$-plane or $|H|>0$ everywhere and the translator is contained in an $(n+1)$-dimensional affine subspace.
